_comment: The app on a phone with no signal, decided here and nowhere else. vite/offline.js reads this at build: every built file that no pack claims and core-skip does not drop is the core, saved on the first visit (the app's code, styles, fonts, icons). A pack is extra, saved only when the reader asks in Settings: 'match' claims built files by path, 'api' + 'count' names server answers (bytes measured once, since the build cannot ask the server). 'keep' lists the server answers worth keeping once seen, so what was opened still opens; anything about a person (progress, profile) is left out on purpose. wait-ms is how long a slow connection is waited for before the saved copy is shown instead. Copy for Settings and the offline banner is under 'copy'.
